about: Everyday things modelled in 3D in code, shown as a studio render (the default) or a print of it (halftone, engraving, dither, type). A technical product (hardware) without photographs may show the object of its own kind as its hero and statement picture, as a render, when a kit holds that kind; a product of site-kind other (a chair, a bike, a lamp) shows none (MO-08), and a software, tech or games page may use one as its moment, in a print. Never an object of another kind, never on a place page, never captioned. Contract: _print-core/README.md.
load: assets/objects/_print-core/auto.js (mounts every [data-print]); or import <id>/object.js and call mount(el, opts).

objects.name: Cup and saucer
objects.line: A cup on its saucer. Click to stir.
objects.product: A cup, a mug or a tableware set: the product of a ceramics or tableware maker.
objects.for: Ceramics and tableware, kitchen and home goods; on a software page, a card about a break, a routine or a morning. A product page of site-kind other (a chair, a bike, a lamp, coffee) shows none: its photographs lead (MO-08); only a technical product (hardware) of that very kind may show it.

objects.name: Bicycle wheel
objects.line: A bicycle wheel. Click to spin it up.
objects.product: A wheel, a wheelset or a hub: the product of a maker of wheels or wheel parts. Never a whole bicycle: a wheel does not show a bike.
objects.for: Wheels and wheel parts, cycling parts and service; on a software page, a card about motion, speed or a mechanism. A product page of site-kind other (a chair, a bike, a lamp, coffee) shows none: its photographs lead (MO-08); only a technical product (hardware) of that very kind may show it.

objects.name: Desk lamp
objects.line: A balanced-arm desk lamp. Click to switch it on.
objects.product: A desk or task lamp: the product of a lighting maker.
objects.for: Lighting and furniture; on a software page, a card about focus, reading or working late. A product page of site-kind other (a chair, a bike, a lamp, coffee) shows none: its photographs lead (MO-08); only a technical product (hardware) of that very kind may show it.

objects.name: Desk globe
objects.line: A desk globe. Click to spin it.
objects.product: A globe: the product of a maker of globes, maps or school supplies.
objects.for: Maps and globes; on a software page, a card about regions, countries, languages or shipping. A product page of site-kind other (a chair, a bike, a lamp, coffee) shows none: its photographs lead (MO-08); only a technical product (hardware) of that very kind may show it.

objects.name: Playing cards
objects.line: A stack of playing cards. Click to fan them out.
objects.product: A deck of playing cards or a card game: the product of a games or print maker.
objects.for: Card and board games; on a games or software page, a card about play, a hand, a draw or a deal. A product page of site-kind other (a chair, a bike, a lamp, coffee) shows none: its photographs lead (MO-08); only a technical product (hardware) of that very kind may show it.
